scripts.test: node scripts/verify.mjs && npm run prisma:generate -w @house-help/backend && npm run test -w @house-help/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run prisma:generate -w @house-help/backend && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.quality:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:security && npm run test:coverage -w @house-help/backend && npm run build
scripts.release:check: npm run quality:check && node scripts/verify-mobile-release.mjs customer-app && node scripts/verify-mobile-release.mjs provider-app && node scripts/verify-phase9.mjs
